name: arrest-lightning-graveyard-ability-refused-without-matching-element
notes: Arrest Lightning's graveyard ability needs the Element Bonus: a Warrior with a FIRE champion cannot use it.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] [Element Bonus] (1), Banish this card from your graveyard: Put a static counter on target arcane element object you control and each object linked to it.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. IsElementBonusActive() was hard-wired to return true ('TODO: Delete this'), so every [Element Bonus] always applied. It now requires the champion's element to match the card's element.
